Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 438 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicant apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.13 of 2025 registered at P.S.
Bilkhiriya District -Bhopal (M.P) for the offence punishable under Sections 318(4) of BNS and Sections 420 and 409 of the IPC.
3.
Prosecution story in brief is that applicant took Rs.15,00,000/- from complainant for getting tender of Rs.60,00,00,000/-(Rupees Sixty Crores) awarded to complainant.

4 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the instant case, NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12432 2 MCRC-6775-2025 parties have compromised the matter and amount received by applicant has been returned to complainant.
In this connection, he has also filed relevant documents.
It is also urged that in the instant case, investigation is almost over.
No custodial interrogation is required.
Applicant is Government servant.
Applicant and complainant were known to each other.
There are many technical flaws in the case.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be granted benefit of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the bail application.
6. Learned Advocate for the objector submits that he has no objection, if applicant is released on anticipatory bail.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
8. Having regard to nature of offence as well as evidence available on record, prima-facie, no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
9. Hence, this anticipatory bail application is hereby dismissed.
